L3-0645.note: N. 力 L3-0443 owns bare "strength"; 实力 is the strength a team or country actually has.

L4-0673.note: N. 刷 L4-0671 ships "to brush", which strips to the same answer as a bare "brush".

L5-0934.note: V. The 预- prefix is "in advance"; 期望 L5-0569 keeps the hopes-placed-on sense.

L1-0448.note: N. Second gloss reworded off "right, to the right", whose commas made the row unparseable. 右 L1-0447 keeps "the right-hand side".

L3-0478.note: N. "esp." is dictionary shorthand; 新闻 L2 ships "news".

L5-0015.note: V. 报答 is gratitude paid back to a benefactor (报答父母); "to requite" is archaic. 回报 L5-0339 takes the reciprocation sense.

L5-0069.note: N. CEDICT gives one long clause and the picker reduced it to a bare "part", which is 部分 L3's answer; 部位 names a specific region, usually of the body.

L2-0530.note: N. 运动 L2-0702 owns "sport"; 体育 is the school subject and the sporting world, not an activity you do.

L4-0465.note: N. 眼泪 L4-0852 ships "tears"; 泪水 is the water itself, so it must not read as a bare plural of the same word.

L5-0164.note: N. The organ. 脑子 L5-0524 takes the colloquial "mind", so neither is a plural of the other.

L5-0524.note: N. Colloquial 脑子 is where you think (动脑子), against 大脑 L5-0164 the organ.

L5-0527.note: N. Not a bare "year" — 年 owns that, and 岁月 L5-0733 must not read as its plural.

L5-0733.note: N. 岁月 is time as it passes, not a count of years.
